intent: Intermediate signals and marts for the Day-Off Index

edits.new_content:
-- Every signal as one daily value per (source, signal, geo, UTC day).
-- A value that could not be read is NULL with is_available = false: unavailable, never zero.
with trends as (
    select
        'google_trends' as source,
        'search:' || lower(term) as signal,
        case term_group when 'day_off' then 'day_off_intent' else 'hype' end as signal_family,
        geo,
        interest_date as signal_date,
        case when not is_partial then cast(interest as double) end as signal_value,
        not is_partial as is_available
    from {{ ref('stg_trends__interest') }}
),

bluesky as (
    select
        'bluesky' as source,
        case gta_filter when 'gta' then 'posts:day_off_gta' else 'posts:day_off' end as signal,
        case gta_filter when 'gta' then 'day_off_gta' else 'day_off_intent' end as signal_family,
        'WORLD' as geo,
        hit_date as signal_date,
        case when bool_and(is_available) then cast(sum(hits_total) as double) end as signal_value,
        bool_and(is_available) as is_available
    from {{ ref('stg_bluesky__daily_hits') }}
    group by gta_filter, hit_date
),

hacker_news as (
    select
        'hacker_news' as source,
        case gta_filter when 'gta' then 'posts:day_off_gta' else 'posts:day_off' end as signal,
        case gta_filter when 'gta' then 'day_off_gta' else 'day_off_intent' end as signal_family,
        'WORLD' as geo,
        hit_date as signal_date,
        case when bool_and(is_available) then cast(sum(hits_total) as double) end as signal_value,
        bool_and(is_available) as is_available
    from {{ ref('stg_hn__daily_hits') }}
    group by gta_filter, hit_date
),

wikipedia as (
    select
        'wikipedia' as source,
        'pageviews:' || lower(article) as signal,
        case when article = 'Grand_Theft_Auto_VI' then 'hype' else 'reference' end as signal_family,
        'WORLD' as geo,
        view_date as signal_date,
        cast(views as double) as signal_value,
        true as is_available
    from {{ ref('stg_wiki__pageviews') }}
)

select * from trends
union all
select * from bluesky
union all
select * from hacker_news
union all
select * from wikipedia

-- One row per UTC day of the study window and its control year, with its place relative
-- to that year's release Thursday.
with spine as (
    select cast(range as date) as date_day
    from range(date '2025-10-01', date '2027-01-01', interval 1 day)
),

years as (
    select
        date_day,
        case when date_day >= date '2026-01-01' then 2026 else 2025 end as study_year
    from spine
),

anchored as (
    select
        date_day,
        study_year,
        case study_year when 2026 then date '2026-11-19' else date '2025-11-20' end as release_day
    from years
)

select
    date_day,
    study_year,
    release_day,
    cast(date_day - release_day as integer) as days_from_release,
    isodow(date_day) as iso_day_of_week,
    dayname(date_day) as day_name,
    case cast(date_day - release_day as integer)
        when 0 then 'release'
        when -7 then 'baseline'
    end as comparison_role,
    study_year = 2026 and date_day = release_day as is_gta_release_day
from anchored

select
    md5(
        signals.source || '|' || signals.signal || '|' || signals.geo || '|'
        || cast(signals.signal_date as varchar)
    ) as signal_day_key,
    signals.source,
    signals.signal,
    signals.signal_family,
    signals.geo,
    signals.signal_date,
    signals.signal_value,
    signals.is_available,
    dates.study_year,
    dates.days_from_release,
    dates.iso_day_of_week,
    dates.comparison_role
from {{ ref('int_signals__daily') }} as signals
inner join {{ ref('dim_date') }} as dates
    on signals.signal_date = dates.date_day

-- Release Thursday over the Thursday before, per signal and study year.
with pairs as (
    select
        source,
        signal,
        signal_family,
        geo,
        study_year,
        max(signal_value) filter (where comparison_role = 'baseline') as baseline_value,
        max(signal_value) filter (where comparison_role = 'release') as release_value,
        coalesce(bool_or(is_available) filter (where comparison_role = 'baseline'), false)
            as is_baseline_available,
        coalesce(bool_or(is_available) filter (where comparison_role = 'release'), false)
            as is_release_available
    from {{ ref('fct_signal_daily') }}
    where comparison_role is not null
    group by source, signal, signal_family, geo, study_year
)

select
    md5(source || '|' || signal || '|' || geo || '|' || cast(study_year as varchar))
        as thursday_lift_key,
    source,
    signal,
    signal_family,
    geo,
    study_year,
    case study_year when 2026 then date '2026-11-19' else date '2025-11-20' end as release_day,
    baseline_value,
    release_value,
    is_baseline_available,
    is_release_available,
    case
        when is_baseline_available and is_release_available and baseline_value > 0
            then release_value / baseline_value
    end as lift,
    signal_family = 'day_off_intent'
    and source in ('google_trends', 'bluesky', 'reddit')
    and (source <> 'google_trends' or baseline_value >= 5) as is_index_component
from pairs

-- The Day-Off Index: geometric mean of per-source lifts (each source the geometric mean of
-- its own component signals), x 100. 100 is a normal week.
with components as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_thursday_lift') }}
    where is_index_component
),

by_source as (
    select
        study_year,
        source,
        count(*) as signals_total,
        count(lift) as signals_with_lift,
        case
            when count(lift) = count(*) then exp(avg(ln(greatest(lift, 0.01))))
        end as source_lift
    from components
    group by study_year, source
)

select
    study_year,
    case study_year when 2026 then date '2026-11-19' else date '2025-11-20' end as release_day,
    count(*) as sources_total,
    count(source_lift) as sources_with_lift,
    case
        when count(source_lift) = count(*) then 100 * exp(avg(ln(source_lift)))
    end as day_off_index,
    max(case when source = 'google_trends' then source_lift end) as google_trends_lift,
    max(case when source = 'bluesky' then source_lift end) as bluesky_lift,
    max(case when source = 'reddit' then source_lift end) as reddit_lift
from by_source
group by study_year

models:
  - name: int_signals__daily
    description: 'One row per signal per day: every source''s daily value in one shape.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - source
            - signal
            - geo
            - signal_date
          population:
            rule: Every staged day of every source; Bluesky and Hacker News seeds are summed per day and filter.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Combining seed phrases
              chosen: sum hits across seeds per day
              evidence: default
              detail: a post matching two seeds counts twice; the double count is the same on both Thursdays, so the lift is unaffected in expectation
            - decision: A partial or failed day
              chosen: signal_value NULL, is_available false
              evidence: request
              detail: 'docs/methodology.md: missing is unavailable, never zero'
            - decision: Trends partial days
              chosen: treated as unavailable
              evidence: default
              detail: Google flags the latest day isPartial while it fills in
    columns:
      - name: source
        description: google_trends, bluesky, reddit, hacker_news or wikipedia.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal
        description: What is counted, e.g. search:pto, posts:day_off, posts:day_off_gta, pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal_family
        description: day_off_intent (people saying or searching they are off), day_off_gta (the same, mentioning GTA), hype (interest in GTA itself), reference.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: geo
        description: US or WORLD. Only Google Trends has a US slice.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal_date
        description: UTC day (Google's own day for Trends).
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal_value
        description: Counts for posts and pageviews; relative 0-100 interest for Trends. Never add across signals or sources.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: 'NULL when the value could not be read: unavailable, never zero.'
              aggregation: sum
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: count or index (see signal)
      - name: is_available
        description: False when any part of the day's value failed to load or was partial.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null

models:
  - name: dim_date
    description: One row per UTC day from 2025-10-01 to 2026-12-31, placed relative to that year's release Thursday.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - date_day
          population:
            rule: Every calendar day in the spine; 2025 days belong to the control year (anchor Thu 20 Nov 2025), 2026 days to the study (anchor Thu 19 Nov 2026).
          assumptions:
            - decision: Control anchor
              chosen: Thu 20 Nov 2025 vs Thu 13 Nov 2025
              evidence: request
              detail: same week of November, one year earlier, both a week before US Thanksgiving week
    columns:
      - name: date_day
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: study_year
        description: 2026 = GTA 6 release year; 2025 = seasonality control.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: release_day
        description: That year's anchor Thursday.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: days_from_release
        description: 0 on the anchor Thursday, -7 on the baseline Thursday.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
              unit: days
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: iso_day_of_week
        description: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: day_name
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: comparison_role
        description: '''release'' or ''baseline''.'
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: NULL on days that are neither Thursday of the comparison
      - name: is_gta_release_day
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null

              model: int_signals__daily
              key:
                source: source
                signal: signal
                geo: geo
                signal_date: signal_date

              evidence: default
              detail: the inner join to dim_date is a filter on the study spine

    columns:

models:
  - name: fct_thursday_lift
    description: 'One row per signal per study year: the release Thursday''s value over the Thursday before.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - thursday_lift_key
          population:
            rule: Every (source, signal, geo, study year) that has a row on either compared Thursday.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Index components
              chosen: day_off_intent signals of google_trends, bluesky and reddit
              evidence: request
              detail: Hacker News is too sparse (334 hits in 107 days, .dex/review/05); Wikipedia is hype or reference only
            - decision: Low-resolution Trends terms
              chosen: excluded from the index when the baseline is below 5
              evidence: data
              detail: Trends rounds to integers; a baseline of 1-4 turns a one-point wobble into a 25-100% lift
    columns:
      - name: thursday_lift_key
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: source
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal_family
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: geo
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: study_year
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: release_day
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: baseline_value
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: NULL when the baseline Thursday is not available
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: count or index
      - name: release_value
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: NULL until the release Thursday has closed and loaded
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: count or index
      - name: is_baseline_available
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: is_release_available
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: lift
        description: release_value / baseline_value. 1.0 = a normal week.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: NULL unless both Thursdays are available and the baseline is above zero
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: ratio
      - name: is_index_component
        description: True for the day-off intent signals of Google Trends (baseline >= 5), Bluesky and Reddit.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null

models:
  - name: fct_day_off_index
    description: 'One row per study year: the Day-Off Index and each source''s lift.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - study_year
          population:
            rule: Study years with at least one index component.
          assumptions:
            - decision: How lifts combine
              chosen: geometric mean within each source, then across sources, equal weights
              evidence: default
              detail: lifts are ratios; the geometric mean keeps one noisy source from dominating
            - decision: A zero lift
              chosen: floored at 0.01 before the log
              evidence: default
              detail: ln(0) is undefined; a component that fell to zero still pulls the index down hard
            - decision: Incomplete index
              chosen: NULL until every component source has a lift
              evidence: request
              detail: missing is unavailable, never zero
    columns:
      - name: study_year
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: release_day
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: time
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: sources_total
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
              unit: count
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: sources_with_lift
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: attribute
              null_rule: never
              unit: count
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: day_off_index
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              null_rule: NULL until every component source has a lift
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: index (100 = normal week)
      - name: google_trends_lift
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: ratio
      - name: bluesky_lift
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: ratio
      - name: reddit_lift
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: measure
              aggregation: max
              additivity: non_additive
              unit: ratio
